I0001-01.summary: Substring host check sends the service token to lookalike git remote hosts

I0001-02.summary: cloneRepo sends the service token to any host whose URL contains github.com

texts.F18: `cloneRepo` passes the user-supplied `remoteUrl` straight to `gitAuthArgs` with the service token, so `git clone` sends the token to any host whose URL contains the substring `github.com`.

I0002.summary: fetchCurrentUser errors reject loadDashboard uncaught; dashboard never renders

texts.F03: `loadDashboard` awaits `fetchCurrentUser` with no error handling. A failed request from `fetchCurrentUser` rejects the dashboard load, and the page never renders.

I0003.summary: Unvalidated repository ids let template and cache routes escape REPOS_DIR

texts.F12: The repository id is stored with no character or path validation and later used as a directory name. An id such as `../../etc` escapes the repositories directory on both the template route and the cache listing route, and an absolute path such as `/etc` escapes it on the cache listing route.
texts.F14: The template route builds its base directory from the raw repository id.

I0004-01.summary: Non-admins can delete system-owned repos through the deleteRepo route

I0004-02.summary: Non-admin deleteRepo also deletes repos owned by 'system'

I0006.summary: getBuild CI request has no timeout or abort signal

I0007.summary: ADMIN_CIDR 0.0.0.0/0 makes every client an admin for auditLog

I0008.summary: No tests for encrypt/decrypt round trip and tamper detection in crypto.ts

I0009.summary: getIssue Jira request has no timeout or abort signal

I0010.summary: searchAssigned interpolates unescaped email into JQL query

I0012.summary: createFixTask writes feedback separately, so emit sees null feedback

texts.F17: `createFixTask` inserts the task as `running` with `feedback: null` and writes the feedback in a second statement. `emit` sends `{ ...task }` with the stale `null` feedback.
